name: C1 — Advanced
description: Operate in Mandarin for business, academic, and journalistic contexts. Argue a position, structure formal discourse, and use 成語 with confidence.

guide.intro: Business Mandarin lives in a register far above everyday speech. The same idea you'd say with 因為...所以 over coffee gets dressed up with 鑑於... 因此 in a meeting. Three habits define the register: connectives that tie clauses together, nominalized topics with 至於, and a default to 您 / 貴 honorifics.

sections.text: Formal causal connectives

Casual Chinese uses 因為 X 所以 Y. In formal writing and meetings, you upgrade to 鑑於 X，因此 Y ("in view of X, therefore Y") or 由於 X，故 Y ("owing to X, hence Y"). 因此 and 故 are interchangeable for "therefore", but 故 sounds bookish.

rows.source: 鑑於市場環境的變化，我們因此調整了戰略。
rows.pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, wǒmen yīncǐ tiáozhěng le zhànlüè.
rows.translation: In view of market changes, we have therefore adjusted our strategy.

rows.source: 由於成本上升，公司因此決定提價。
rows.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī yīncǐ juédìng tíjià.
rows.translation: Owing to rising costs, the company has accordingly decided to raise prices.

rows.source: 因為成本上升，所以我們漲價了。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngběn shàngshēng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǎngjià le.
rows.translation: Because costs rose, we raised prices. (casual)

sections.text: 然而 vs 但是 — "however"
但是 works in any register. 然而 is the formal cousin you reach for in reports, op-eds, and presentations. 不過 sits in between — written Chinese friendly but not stiff.

rows: Strong contrast in essays, news, reports.

sections.text: 至於 — topic shift

至於 X ("as for X") moves the spotlight to a new sub-topic and is heavily used in structured talks. The phrase always introduces a fresh clause and is followed by a comma. Think of it as the spoken equivalent of a slide transition.

rows.source: 營收方面我們超出預期。至於成本，仍需進一步控制。
rows.pinyin: Yíngshōu fāngmiàn wǒmen chāochū yùqī. Zhìyú chéngběn, réng xū jìnyībù kòngzhì.
rows.translation: On revenue we exceeded expectations. As for costs, they still need to be controlled further.

rows.source: 至於您提到的合作方式，我們下週再深入討論。
rows.pinyin: Zhìyú nín tídào de hézuò fāngshì, wǒmen xiàzhōu zài shēnrù tǎolùn.
rows.translation: As for the form of cooperation you mentioned, let us discuss it in depth next week.

sections.text: 貴 — honorific prefix

貴 ("honored") attaches to nouns referring to the other party's affiliations: 貴公司 (your company), 貴校 (your school), 貴姓 (your honored surname). Use 貴 anywhere a respectful tone is owed; in return, refer to your own side with the humble 敝 (敝公司 "my humble company") or simply 我方 ("our side").
Mixing registers will make you sound off. Once you open a meeting with 貴公司, stay in formal mode: keep using 您, swap 但是 for 然而, and lean on 至於 for transitions.

lessons.title: Opening a meeting
lessons.description: Greet, thank, and frame the agenda

exercises.prompt: 承蒙貴公司的支援 (chéng méng guì gōngsī de zhīchí)
exercises.hint: What does this formal phrase mean?
exercises.answer: Thanks to your company's support
exercises.explanation: 承蒙 is a formal "thanks to / kindly receiving"; 貴公司 is the honorific "your company".

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's agenda mainly covers three items"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 議程 主要 包括 三 項 內容

exercises.prompt: the formal opener to its function

pairs.right: Thanks for taking time to attend

pairs.left: 請允許我做個簡單的介紹
pairs.right: Allow me to make a brief introduction
Let's begin with item one on the agenda
I hope we can reach consensus today

exercises.prompt: "貴公司" is the formal way to say ___
exercises.answer: Your company
exercises.explanation: The 貴 honorific elevates references to the other party.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal opener?
options: 感謝各位撥冗出席今天的會議
感謝大家抽空來開個會
感謝各位撥冗出席這次破會
尊敬的各位嘉賓，歡迎蒞臨
exercises.answer: 感謝各位撥冗出席這次破會
exercises.explanation: 撥冗出席 is formal; 破會 ("crap meeting") is dismissive slang. The casual second option is internally consistent; the third option mixes a stiff opener with a slur. The other two stay in register.

exercises.prompt: the meeting role to its Chinese title
Build "Allow me on behalf of the company to extend a warm welcome to everyone"
exercises.answer: 請 允許 我 代表 公司 對 各位 表示 熱烈 的 歡迎

exercises.prompt: Tap the honorific pronoun you hear
exercises.answer: 請問您貴姓
exercises.explanation: 您 (formal) versus 你 (neutral) is the C1 register dial. 貴姓 ("honored surname") only pairs with 您.

exercises.prompt: Which transition best opens the agenda after greetings?
options: 下面我們進入正式議程
exercises.answer: 下面我們進入正式議程
exercises.explanation: 進入正式議程 ("enter the formal agenda") is the standard transition. The others either drop register or sound dictatorial.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "今天的會議主要 ___ 三項議程" (mainly covers)
exercises.answer: 包括
exercises.explanation: 包括 ("includes") is the neutral choice. 涉及 ("touches on") and 圍繞 ("revolves around") also work depending on emphasis.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the tight schedule today, please make your remarks concise"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 今天 時間 緊迫 ， 請 各位 發言 儘量 簡短

exercises.prompt: Which is the closest near-synonym distinction at C1?
options: 我認為 (current view) ≠ 我以為 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.answer: 我認為 (current view) ≠ 我以為 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.explanation: 我以為 implies the speaker has been corrected. 我認為 is a current claim. Mishearing one for the other inverts the message.

exercises.answer: Thank you all for taking the time to attend
acceptableAnswers: thanks for taking time to attend
thank you for attending despite your busy schedules
thanks for making time to attend
exercises.context: Opening line of a formal meeting
exercises.explanation: 撥冗 is a literary phrase meaning to set aside busy commitments; 出席 is formal attendance.

exercises.prompt: Complete the opener: "請允許我 ___ 公司向各位致以誠摯的問候" (on behalf of)
exercises.answer: 代表
exercises.explanation: 代表 + 單位/公司 = on behalf of an organization.

exercises.prompt: Which transition signals that the chair is moving to the first agenda item?
exercises.answer: 下面請看第一項
exercises.explanation: 下面請看第一項 is the standard meeting transition; the others either drop register or change topic.

exercises.prompt: Build "First of all, on behalf of the organizing committee, please allow me to extend a warm welcome to everyone"
exercises.answer: 首先 請 允許 我 代表 組委會 向 各位 表示 熱烈 的 歡迎

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal time-pressure cue you hear
exercises.answer: 鑑於今天時間緊迫
exercises.explanation: 鑑於 + 緊迫 is the formal pairing; 因為 is neutral; 充裕 inverts the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "你姓什麼" into formal: "請問您 ___"
exercises.answer: 貴姓
exercises.explanation: 貴姓 is the formal counterpart of 姓什麼; 貴 elevates the addressee.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence best opens a formal welcome at a press event?
options: 尊敬的各位嘉賓，歡迎蒞臨今天的釋出會
exercises.answer: 尊敬的各位嘉賓，歡迎蒞臨今天的釋出會
exercises.explanation: 蒞臨 is a literary honorific for "arrive"; pairs with 尊敬的 and 嘉賓 for full formality.

exercises.answer: I hope we can reach a consensus today
acceptableAnswers: i hope we can reach consensus today
hope we reach an agreement today
exercises.context: Framing the goal of a meeting
exercises.explanation: 達成共識 = reach consensus, a fixed business collocation.

lessons.title: Negotiation language
lessons.description: Soften, push back, propose terms

exercises.prompt: Which phrase most diplomatically rejects a proposal?
options: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
exercises.answer: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
exercises.explanation: 恐怕 ("I'm afraid") + 難以接受 ("hard to accept") softens the rejection while staying firm.

exercises.prompt: Build "On the price issue we hope you can reconsider"
exercises.answer: 在 價格 問題 上 我們 希望 貴方 可以 再 考慮 一下

exercises.prompt: 雙方各讓一步 (shuāngfāng gè ràng yí bù)
exercises.hint: What does this negotiation phrase suggest?
exercises.answer: Each side makes a concession
exercises.explanation: Literally "both sides each yield one step" — classic negotiation phrasing for a compromise.

exercises.answer: our bottom line
exercises.explanation: 底線 = bottom line, the lowest acceptable terms.

exercises.prompt: the negotiation move to its Chinese phrase
Pick the supplier-negotiation phrasing that signals a willingness to compromise without giving up leverage:
options: 在數量上我們可以讓步，但單價必須維持
你們說什麼我們都同意
這個條件我們絕對不接受，不用談了
exercises.answer: 在數量上我們可以讓步，但單價必須維持
exercises.explanation: Concede on volume, hold the unit price — classic negotiation move expressed in formal Mandarin.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the long-term partnership, we are willing to make appropriate concessions on the payment terms"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 長期 合作 關係 ， 我方 願意 在 付款 條件 上 做出 適當 讓步

exercises.prompt: Tap the formality marker you hear in the negotiation reply
exercises.spokenText: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
options: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
現在我們想你們再考慮一下
目前我們希望你方再考慮一下
exercises.answer: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
exercises.explanation: 目前 (formal "currently") + 希望 (formal "hope") + 貴方 ("your honorable side") all align in register. Listening for 現在/目前 and 你方/貴方 catches register at speed.

exercises.prompt: 達成共識 (dá chéng gòng shí)
exercises.hint: What does this meeting-outcome phrase mean?
exercises.answer: Reach a consensus
exercises.explanation: 達成 ("reach") + 共識 ("shared understanding") — standard meeting outcome language.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "雙方在主要條款上已經 ___ 共識" (have reached)
exercises.answer: 達成
exercises.explanation: 達成共識 / 達成協議 — fixed business collocations.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我覺得這個價格太貴了" into formal supplier-negotiation register?
options: 我方認為該報價偏高，希望貴方能予以調整
你這個價格也太貴了吧
exercises.answer: 我方認為該報價偏高，希望貴方能予以調整
exercises.explanation: 我方 / 該報價 / 予以調整 are all formal upgrades of 我們/這個價格/改一下.

exercises.answer: If I may speak frankly
exercises.explanation: 恕 ("forgive") + 直言 ("straight talk") — formal lead-in to candid disagreement.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "恐怕這個方案我們 ___ 接受" (hard to)
exercises.answer: 難以
exercises.explanation: 難以 + V is the formal counterpart of 很難 + V.

exercises.prompt: Which counter-offer phrasing keeps full formal register?
options: 我方提議如下，敬請貴方斟酌
我們這邊覺得這樣可以
exercises.answer: 我方提議如下，敬請貴方斟酌
exercises.explanation: 我方 / 敬請 / 斟酌 ("deliberate") form a register-consistent formal proposal.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the two sides hold differences, we hope to reach a consensus through consultation"
exercises.answer: 雙方 雖 存在 分歧 ， 但 希望 通過 協商 達成 共識

exercises.prompt: Tap the diplomatic rejection you hear
exercises.spokenText: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
options: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
這個方案我們不能接受
恐怕這個方案我們可以接受
exercises.answer: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
exercises.explanation: 恐怕 + 難以 softens; the direct alternatives sound flat; the last inverts meaning.

exercises.prompt: Complete the concession: "在數量上我們可以 ___，但單價必須維持" (yield)
exercises.answer: 讓步
exercises.explanation: 讓步 = make a concession; 妥協 = compromise — both fit; 讓步 is more common in negotiations.

exercises.prompt: Which signals a firm but polite deal-breaker?
exercises.answer: 這是我們的底線
exercises.explanation: 底線 = bottom line. The other options abdicate authority or sound dictatorial.

exercises.answer: Please allow us to think it over
acceptableAnswers: please give us time to consider
exercises.explanation: 請允許 = please permit, a formal hedge that buys time.

exercises.prompt: 通過協商達成共識 (tōng guò xié shāng dá chéng gòng shí)
exercises.hint: What does this negotiation outcome phrase mean?
options: Force the other side to agree
exercises.answer: Reach a consensus through consultation
exercises.explanation: 通過協商 = via consultation; 達成共識 = arrive at shared understanding.

lessons.title: Formal email & letters
lessons.description: Salutations, body, and sign-offs

exercises.prompt: the email element to its position

pairs.left: 茲就貴公司提出的方案，回覆如下

exercises.prompt: 茲 (zī)
exercises.hint: What does this character mean in a formal email?
exercises.answer: Hereby / herewith
exercises.explanation: 茲 is a classical-style word still used in formal correspondence to mean "hereby".

exercises.prompt: Build "Attached please find the contract draft, please kindly review"
exercises.answer: 附件 是 合同 草稿 敬請 查閱

exercises.prompt: "此致 敬禮" closes a Chinese formal letter, equivalent to ___
exercises.answer: Sincerely
exercises.explanation: Standard formal sign-off; literally "to here, salute".

exercises.prompt: 敬請查閱
exercises.hint: What does this formal email phrase mean?
exercises.answer: Please kindly review
exercises.explanation: 敬請 ("respectfully request") + 查閱 ("check / read") — fixed honorific request.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this formal email body:
options: 茲就貴公司提出的方案，我方回覆如下
茲就貴公司的提案，我方答覆如下
茲就你們那個方案，我方回覆如下
關於貴公司的方案，我方答覆如下
exercises.answer: 茲就你們那個方案，我方回覆如下
exercises.explanation: 茲/我方 are classical-register formal; 你們那個方案 is colloquial pointing language. Mixing them sounds jarring; the other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal email line "In view of the contract you provided, we hereby reply as follows"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 貴方 提供 的 合同 ， 茲 回覆 如下

exercises.prompt: the email element to its Chinese standard line

pairs.right: 主題：關於合同條款的回覆
茲就貴公司提出的方案，回覆如下

exercises.prompt: Tap the salutation register you hear
exercises.answer: 尊敬的王總您好
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 + 您 = consistently formal. The 你/您 swap downgrades register; 親愛的 sounds personal; 啊 is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "麻煩你看一下" into formal email language: "敬請 ___"
exercises.answer: 查閱
exercises.explanation: 敬請查閱/審閱/過目 are interchangeable formal requests for the recipient to read.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence appropriately confirms attachment delivery in formal register?
options: 附件中是合同草稿，請貴方審閱
我把合同貼在下面了，看一下
exercises.answer: 附件中是合同草稿，請貴方審閱
exercises.explanation: 附件中 + 貴方 + 審閱 = formal alignment. The other three slide into casual or commanding tone.

exercises.source: 茲就貴公司提出的方案，回覆如下
exercises.answer: Hereby in response to the proposal raised by your company, we reply as follows
acceptableAnswers: regarding the proposal your company raised, we reply as follows
in response to your company's proposal, our reply is as follows
exercises.context: Opening line of a formal reply
exercises.explanation: 茲 = hereby; 就 = regarding; 回覆如下 = reply is as follows.

exercises.prompt: Complete the salutation register: "___ 的王總：" (Respected)
exercises.answer: 尊敬
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 + title is the standard formal salutation.

exercises.prompt: Which sign-off is appropriate for a formal letter to a senior executive?
exercises.answer: 此致 敬禮
exercises.explanation: 此致 敬禮 is the canonical formal close; the others are colloquial farewells.

exercises.prompt: Build "Hereby regarding the matter you raised, our reply is as follows"
exercises.answer: 茲 就 貴方 所 提 事項 ， 答覆 如下

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal acknowledgment line you hear
exercises.spokenText: 敬請查閱附件中的合同草稿
options: 敬請查閱附件中的合同草稿
敬請查閱附件中的合同正本
exercises.answer: 敬請查閱附件中的合同草稿
exercises.explanation: 敬請查閱 is the honorific request; 草稿 vs 正本 distinguishes draft from final.

exercises.prompt: Replace casual "快回我" with formal: "敬請 ___" (await your reply)
exercises.answer: 回覆
exercises.explanation: 敬請回復 / 敬請賜復 are the formal counterparts.

exercises.prompt: Which body opener best fits a reply to a contract draft?
options: 茲就貴方提供的合同草稿，回覆如下
你們發的合同，我看完了
exercises.answer: 茲就貴方提供的合同草稿，回覆如下
exercises.explanation: Only the first keeps formal register throughout.

exercises.answer: Please kindly review
exercises.context: Closing request in an email with attachments
exercises.explanation: 敬請 (respectfully request) + 查閱 (look over) — a frozen formal phrase.

exercises.prompt: Pick the line that correctly attaches a document in formal register:
options: 附件中是合同草稿，敬請貴方查閱
exercises.answer: 附件中是合同草稿，敬請貴方查閱
exercises.explanation: 附件中 + 敬請 + 貴方 keep register aligned throughout.

lessons.title: Discussing performance
lessons.description: Numbers, growth, projections

exercises.prompt: "營收同比增長百分之十五" means revenue grew ___
exercises.answer: 15% year-over-year
exercises.explanation: 同比 specifically means "compared with the same period last year". 環比 = quarter-over-quarter / period-over-period.

exercises.prompt: Build "This quarter's profit is significantly higher than expected"
exercises.answer: 本 季度 的 利潤 遠 高於 預期

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
"扭虧為盈" describes a company turning ___
exercises.answer: Loss into profit
exercises.explanation: 扭虧為盈 (niǔ kuī wéi yíng) — a fixed business expression for becoming profitable.

exercises.prompt: Tap the comparison metric you hear
exercises.answer: 同比增長百分之十五
exercises.explanation: 同比 (year-over-year) and 環比 (period-over-period) sound and look alike but mean different things. Train your ear to hear 同 vs 環.

exercises.prompt: the KPI term to its meaning
營收同比增長百分之十五，環比下降百分之三
exercises.hint: What does this financial-results line mean?
options: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
Revenue rose 15% this quarter and 3% next quarter
exercises.answer: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
exercises.explanation: Mixed-direction comparisons in earnings are routine. 同比 = vs same period last year; 環比 = vs prior period.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of falling profit margin, the company is therefore strengthening cost control"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 利潤率 下降 ， 公司 因此 加強 成本 控制

exercises.prompt: Tap the figure you hear
exercises.answer: 營業額突破十億
exercises.explanation: C1 listening trains your ear for big numbers. 十億 = 1 billion; 一億 = 100 million; 十萬 = 100,000.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "本季度淨利潤 ___ 上季度增長百分之八" (compared with last quarter)
exercises.answer: 較
exercises.explanation: 較 X 增長 Y is the formal earnings-report frame. 比 also works in neutral register.

exercises.prompt: Which forecast hedge is the most cautious?
options: 我們一定超額完成目標
我們應該可以完成目標
exercises.answer: 我們有望完成目標
exercises.explanation: 有望 ("there is hope") is the standard analyst-grade hedge. 一定 / 必將 are over-confident; 應該可以 is conversational.

exercises.prompt: the financial trend phrase to its meaning

exercises.answer: Turn loss into profit
exercises.explanation: 扭 ("twist") 虧 ("loss") 為 ("into") 盈 ("profit") — a fixed four-character business idiom.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "營收 ___ 增長百分之十五" (year-over-year)
exercises.hint: Compared with the same period last year
exercises.answer: 同比
exercises.explanation: 同比 = year-over-year; 環比 = period-over-period.

exercises.prompt: Which analyst-grade hedge fits an uncertain forecast?
exercises.answer: 有望完成目標
exercises.explanation: 有望 ("there is hope") is the standard cautious projection; the others overcommit.

exercises.prompt: Build "Net profit this quarter rose 8% compared with last quarter"
exercises.answer: 本 季度 淨利潤 較 上 季度 增長 百分之 八

exercises.prompt: Tap the KPI you hear
exercises.answer: 客戶留存率明顯提升
exercises.explanation: Train your ear for 留存 (retention) vs 流失 (churn) vs 增長 (growth).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "本季度利潤 ___ 高於預期" (significantly)
exercises.answer: 遠
exercises.explanation: 遠高於 / 明顯高於 — both work; 遠 is more emphatic.

exercises.prompt: 由盈轉虧 (yóu yíng zhuǎn kuī)
exercises.hint: What does this earnings phrase describe?
exercises.answer: Swing from profit to loss
exercises.explanation: 由 X 轉 Y = shift from X to Y; the inverse of 扭虧為盈.

exercises.answer: Continued sluggishness
exercises.explanation: 持續 ("continuing") + 低迷 ("sluggish / depressed").

lessons.title: Closing & follow-up
lessons.description: Wrapping the meeting and confirming next steps

guide.intro: Academic Chinese is dense, nominalized, and emphasis-heavy. Two structures dominate: 是...的 to spotlight one component of an established fact, and nominalization with 的 / 來說 / 而言 to package whole clauses as topics. Master these and your writing instantly sounds academic.

sections.text: 是...的 — emphasis on a known event

When the listener already knows the action happened and you want to highlight when, where, how, or who did it, wrap that element in 是...的. The 是 sits before the highlighted phrase; 的 closes the sentence.

rows.pinyin: Tā lái le.
rows.translation: He came. (neutral statement)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì zuótiān lái de.
rows.translation: It was yesterday that he came. (when)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
rows.translation: It is from Beijing that he came. (where)

rows.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng yī bā nián chūbǎn de.
rows.translation: This book was published in 2018. (focus on the year)

sections.text: 是...的 only works for events the listener already accepts as fact. If you're announcing fresh news, use 了 instead — 是...的 would sound oddly defensive.
Nominalization with 的話 / 來說 / 而言

Academic writing turns clauses into topic NPs. 對 X 來說 / 對 X 而言 means "as far as X is concerned". 就 X 而言 raises the formality further. These structures let you front a scoped premise before delivering an argument.

rows.source: 對發展中國家來說，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰。
rows.pinyin: Duì fāzhǎn zhōng guójiā lái shuō, qìhòu biànhuà shì jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
rows.translation: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge.

rows.pinyin: Jiù jīngjì xiàoyì ér yán, zhège fāng'àn zuì wéi hélǐ.
rows.translation: In terms of economic benefit, this plan is the most reasonable.

rows.pinyin: Rúguǒ àn zhège biāozhǔn de huà, wǒmen dōu bù hégé.
rows.translation: If we go by this standard, none of us qualify.

sections.text: Hedging your claims
Academic Chinese hedges constantly. 似乎 (it seems), 可能 (possibly), 在一定程度上 (to a certain extent), and 總的來說 (generally speaking) are the four pillars. Stack them to soften strong claims.

exercises.prompt: Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 因此我們得出以下結論

exercises.answer: 因此我們得出以下結論

lessons.title: Hedging & qualifying
lessons.description: Soften claims like a careful scholar

exercises.prompt: Which phrase hedges a generalization the most?
exercises.answer: 在一定程度上
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 ("to a certain extent") signals a partial / qualified claim.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon seems to be related to climate change"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 似乎 與 氣候 變化 有關

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its function

exercises.answer: it is said

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most cautious academic claim?
options: 結果絕對證明氣候變化加速
結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
結果表明氣候變化加速
結果說明氣候變化必然加速
exercises.answer: 結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 stacks two hedges. 絕對/必然/必將 over-claim; 表明 alone is moderate.

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its strength
Pick the near-synonym distinction:
options: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.answer: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient: 我深信 (deeply believe) > 我堅信 ≈ 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (was mistaken). Mishearing flips the message.

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear
exercises.spokenText: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關

這一現象肯定與氣候變化有關
這一現象似乎與氣候變化無關
這一現象一定與氣候變化有關
exercises.answer: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
exercises.explanation: 似乎/肯定/一定 sit at very different hedge levels. 有關/無關 inverts polarity.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still needs further verification"

exercises.answer: 或許

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still requires further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 這 一 觀點 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 進一步 驗證

exercises.prompt: Spot the over-claim that breaks academic hedging:

結果表明氣候變化可能加速

exercises.prompt: "謝謝大家，歡迎提問" closes a talk and means "thank you all, ___ for questions"
exercises.answer: Welcome

聽好了，今天講我的論文

exercises.answer: 綜上 所述 ， 我們 的 研究 有 三 個 主要 發現

exercises.spokenText: 綜上所述這一假設得到驗證

總而言之這一假設得到驗證
總的來說這一假設得到驗證
exercises.answer: 綜上所述這一假設得到驗證

exercises.explanation: 聆聽 ("listen attentively") + 指正 ("point out errors") are formal honorifics.

lessons.title: 由此可見 / 不難看出 — drawing inferences

exercises.prompt: 由此可見 (yóu cǐ kě jiàn)
exercises.hint: What does this discourse marker signal in academic writing?
options: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.answer: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 hands the reader a conclusion drawn from the evidence just presented.

exercises.prompt: the inference phrase

pairs.right: From this it can be seen
It is not hard to see

exercises.answer: 可以認為

可想而知這一趨勢將持續

from this we can see that education is critical to the economy

lessons.title: Dialogue: Thesis defense Q&A
lessons.description: Defend your methodology under formal academic scrutiny

exercises.prompt: Your committee chair is questioning your thesis methodology.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義。
turns.spokenText: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: State the core argument formally — use 旨在
options: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀之形塑作用。
我這篇論文就是說社交媒體怎麼影響年輕人的。
turns.answer: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀之形塑作用。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 然而你的樣本量僅有三百人，是否足以支援如此寬泛的結論？
turns.spokenText: 然而你的樣本量僅有三百人，是否足以支援如此寬泛的結論

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the formal causal frame: "the reason ... is because ..."

turns.answer: 之所以

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 那麼你如何回應質性研究普遍存在的主觀性問題？
turns.spokenText: 那麼你如何回應質性研究普遍存在的主觀性問題

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede then defend — pick the register-appropriate reply
options: 主觀性確實難以避免，然而本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度。
對啊主觀就主觀唄，我儘量客觀了。
嗯主觀是有點，但是沒辦法嘛。
turns.answer: 主觀性確實難以避免，然而本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 三角驗證的具體操作是什麼？請舉一例。
turns.spokenText: 三角驗證的具體操作是什麼？請舉一例

turns.speaker: you

turns.answer: 其

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 理論框架方面，你為何捨棄哈貝馬斯而採用布林迪厄？

turns.speaker: you

options: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯，而非公共領域之話語結構。
我覺得布林迪厄比較好用一些。
哈貝馬斯太老了所以我換了。
turns.answer: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯，而非公共領域之話語結構。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 答辯到此。委員會將另行通知評議結果。
turns.spokenText: 答辯到此，委員會將另行通知評議結果

this research aims to disclose the shaping role of social media on the values of young people

嗯主觀是有點但沒辦法
exercises.answer: 主觀性確實難以避免，然而本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度
exercises.explanation: 確實...然而... is the formal concede-then-pivot frame; 三角驗證 / 增強信度 are technical.

exercises.prompt: Build "This study aims to reveal the shaping effect of social media on the values of young people"

exercises.source: 通過三角驗證以增強信度

我覺得布林迪厄這個想法對

exercises.answer: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯

guide.intro: Classical Chinese threads through modern writing in three little words: 之, 其, 所. They look intimidating but they're not new grammar — they're compressed forms of structures you already know. Recognize them and most literary and academic Chinese opens up.

sections.text: 之 — the literary 的
之 (zhī) is what 的 used to be. In modern Chinese it survives in fixed expressions and titles. Wherever you see 之, mentally substitute 的. The structure 名詞 + 之 + 名詞 = "X's Y" or "Y of X".

sections.text: 其 — "its / their / his / her"
其 (qí) is the literary third-person possessive — equivalent to 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他們的, depending on context. You'll meet it in essays, instructions, and idioms.

rows.pinyin: Qí jiéguǒ lìng rén zhènjīng.

sections.text: 所 — turning verbs into nouns

所 (suǒ) sits before a verb to nominalize the object: 所 + 動詞 = "that which is V-ed". The full pattern is often 名詞 + 所 + 動詞 + 的 + 名詞 = "the X that N V's". It feels ancient but appears constantly in titles and formal speech.

rows.translation: What I have seen (literally: that which I saw)

rows.translation: The efforts we have made

rows.pinyin: Lǐ suǒ dāng rán
rows.translation: As reason dictates / naturally

sections.text: You almost never need to write 之/其/所 yourself in everyday Chinese. The goal is recognition: when you see 其, your brain swaps in 它的; when you see 所...的, you read it as "the thing that is V-ed".

topics.title: News & journalism
topics.description: Read headlines, parse op-eds, follow current events

guide.intro: News Chinese is its own dialect — short, dense, and heavy with cause-effect connectives. Two patterns dominate explanatory writing: 之所以 X 是因為 Y for reverse-order causation, and 不僅 X 而且 Y for stacking points. Get fluent in these and headlines stop being puzzles.

sections.text: 之所以...是因為 — effect first, cause second

Standard order is 因為 X 所以 Y ("because X, so Y"). When you want to lead with the surprising effect and explain it after, flip to 之所以 Y 是因為 X ("the reason Y is because X"). It's a hallmark of essay and op-ed Chinese.

rows.source: 他之所以成功，是因為他從不放棄。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi tā cóng bù fàngqì.
rows.translation: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

rows.source: 中國之所以發展迅速，是因為改革開放的政策。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī suǒ yǐ fāzhǎn xùnsù, shì yīnwèi gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè.
rows.translation: China developed rapidly because of the reform and opening-up policy.

sections.text: 不僅...而且 — "not only... but also"
不僅 X 而且 Y stacks points: not only X, but also Y. The formal form is 不但 X 而且 Y; the literary form 不僅...更 ramps up the second clause.

rows.source: 這部電影不僅獲得了好評，而且票房火爆。
rows.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bùjǐn huòdé le hǎopíng, érqiě piàofáng huǒbào.
rows.translation: This film not only got good reviews but also did huge box office.

rows.source: 他不僅是一位作家，更是一位思想家。
rows.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yí wèi zuòjiā, gèng shì yí wèi sīxiǎngjiā.
rows.translation: He is not only a writer but, even more so, a thinker.

sections.text: Headline grammar
Headlines compress hard. They drop pronouns, particles, and even verbs. Learn these high-frequency journalist verbs and you'll skim headlines in seconds.
據 X 報道 — quick refresher

You met 據報道 at B2, so this is a refresher rather than new ground. At C1, focus on the variants: 據 X 報道 attributes to a named source, while 據悉 ("it is learned") is the unsourced, slightly official cousin. Both anchor the start of a sentence.

rows.source: 據新華社報道，會議將於下週舉行。
rows.pinyin: Jù Xīnhuáshè bàodào, huìyì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
rows.translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, the meeting will be held next week.

rows.source: 據悉，相關部門正在調查此事。
rows.pinyin: Jù xī, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài diàochá cǐ shì.
rows.translation: It is learned that the relevant departments are investigating the matter.

rows.translation: As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed.

rows.translation: Unless he apologizes, I will not forgive him.

sections.text: 雖然...但是 — concede then push back
The strongest debaters concede. 雖然 X 但是 Y ("although X, but Y") signals you've heard the counterpoint and have an answer. Formal upgrade: 儘管 X，然而 Y.

rows.source: 雖然這個方案有風險，但是收益也很大。
rows.pinyin: Suīrán zhège fāng'àn yǒu fēngxiǎn, dànshì shōuyì yě hěn dà.
rows.translation: Although this plan has risks, the returns are also large.

rows.source: 儘管成本上升，然而公司仍然盈利。
rows.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngshēng, rán'ér gōngsī réngrán yínglì.
rows.translation: Although costs rose, the company is nevertheless still profitable.

sections.text: 難道...嗎 — rhetorical question
難道 ("could it really be that") fronts a question to which the speaker assumes the answer is obvious. Used to challenge an assumption or rebuke.

rows.pinyin: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdào ma?
rows.translation: Could it be that you don't know? (You should know!)

rows.pinyin: Nándào zhè jiù shì dá'àn ma?
rows.translation: Is this really the answer?

sections.text: In writing, balance your concessives. A column that opens with 雖然...但是 and closes with 難道...嗎 reads as classic argumentative Chinese.

lessons.title: Stating your position
lessons.description: Open with confidence

exercises.prompt: the opener
Build "In my view, this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看來 這個 觀點 比較 片面

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal for "I firmly believe"?
exercises.answer: 我堅信
exercises.explanation: All four are plausible C1 alternatives, but 堅信 ("firmly believe") is the strongest and most formal — 深信 is close behind, 相信 is neutral, 認定 leans toward "conclude / be convinced".

exercises.answer: without a doubt

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb of belief you hear
exercises.answer: 我認為這個方案可行
exercises.explanation: 認為 ("hold the view that") states a current belief; 以為 ("used to think / mistakenly thought") implies the speaker has since changed their mind. Mishearing one for the other flips the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest gradient ordering for verbs of belief:
options: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
我以為 > 我深信 > 我認為
我覺得 > 我深信 > 我以為
exercises.answer: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient runs from firm conviction to casual impression to mistaken prior view.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided"
exercises.answer: 依 我 之 見 ， 這 一 觀點 雖 具 吸引力 ， 但 略 顯 片面

exercises.prompt: the position-marker to its register
Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看來，這一現象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.answer: 我們
exercises.explanation: 在我們看來 / 在我看來 = formal opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this debate opener:
options: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
在我看來，這個方案存在缺陷
我認為該方案需要進一步完善
exercises.answer: 依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 is literary; 這玩意兒/壓根 are colloquial. Mixing them sounds jarring.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strength of conviction you hear
exercises.answer: 我深信這一觀點
exercises.explanation: 我深信 / 我堅信 / 我相信 / 我認為 sit at four points on the strength dial. C1 listening discriminates them.

exercises.source: 依我之見，這一觀點雖具吸引力，但略顯片面
exercises.answer: In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided
acceptableAnswers: from my perspective, this view is appealing yet rather one-sided
in my opinion, although this view is attractive, it is a bit one-sided
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 (formal opinion frame) + 雖...但 (concessive pivot) + 略顯片面 (somewhat one-sided).

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看來，這一現象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.answer: 我們
exercises.explanation: 在我們看來 = formal collective opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Which opener is MOST literary?
exercises.answer: 依我之見
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 carries a classical-flavored register; the others sit at neutral or casual.

exercises.prompt: Build "I firmly believe that this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 我 堅信 這 一 觀點 較為 片面

exercises.prompt: Tap the literary opinion frame you hear
exercises.spokenText: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
options: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
在我看來這一現象值得深思
我覺得這一現象值得深思
依我之見這一現象無足輕重
exercises.answer: 依我之見這一現象值得深思
exercises.explanation: Listen for register (依我之見 vs 在我看來 vs 我覺得) and 值得/無足 (worth/insignificant).

exercises.answer: Without a doubt
exercises.explanation: 毫無 (utterly without) + 疑問 (doubt).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "我 ___ 這一觀點" (firmly believe)
exercises.answer: 堅信
exercises.explanation: 堅信 / 深信 = firmly believe; both formal.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence preserves formal debate register throughout?
options: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
我覺得這個方案啊不太行
exercises.answer: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 + 該方案 + 存在嚴重缺陷 keeps register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "Without a doubt, this issue warrants deep reflection"
exercises.answer: 毫無 疑問 ， 這 一 問題 值得 深思

lessons.title: Conditionals — 要是, 即使, 只要
lessons.description: Build hypothetical arguments

exercises.prompt: What does "即使下雨我們也要去" mean?
options: If it rains we won't go
Even if it rains we are still going
If it stops raining we'll go
We are going only if it rains
exercises.answer: Even if it rains we are still going

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 會 成功

exercises.prompt: the conditional
Complete: "___ 他道歉，否則我不會原諒他" (Unless...)
exercises.answer: 除非

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if there are setbacks along the way, we will not give up"
exercises.answer: 即使 途 中 遭遇 挫折 ， 我們 也 不會 放棄

exercises.prompt: What does "假如換個角度看，問題或許更清晰" mean?
options: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.answer: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.explanation: 假如 = formal "should / suppose"; 或許 = soft hedge "perhaps".

exercises.prompt: the conditional to its strength
Complete: "___ 你願意傾聽，對方就會願意溝通" (As long as)
exercises.answer: 只要
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Tap the conditional you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
options: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
除非他先道歉否則我們一定讓步
只要他先道歉我們就會讓步
如果他先道歉我們就會讓步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic. C1 listening discriminates the necessary-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal hypothetical version of "if costs were to fall, demand would surge":
options: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
要是成本掉了，需求就會漲
成本要是下來需求肯定上去
成本下來了需求就上去
exercises.answer: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
exercises.explanation: 假如 + 便 + 激增 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 這個 目標 仍 值得 我們 努力

exercises.source: 假如成本下降需求便會激增
exercises.answer: If costs fell, demand would surge
acceptableAnswers: should costs decline, demand would surge
if costs go down demand will rise sharply
exercises.explanation: 假如 (formal 'should / if') + 便 (formal 'then') + 激增 (surge).

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ 他道歉，否則我不會原諒他" (Unless)
exercises.answer: 除非
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 = unless...otherwise.

exercises.prompt: Which conditional expresses a SUFFICIENT condition?
exercises.answer: 只要...就
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y: X alone is enough to make Y happen.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 這個 目標 仍 值得 我們 努力

exercises.prompt: Tap the necessary-condition frame you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
options: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
除非他先道歉否則我們一定讓步
只要他先道歉我們就會讓步
如果他先道歉我們就會讓步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic.

exercises.source: 即使途中遭遇挫折我們也不會放棄
exercises.answer: Even if we encounter setbacks along the way, we will not give up
acceptableAnswers: even with setbacks on the way we will not give up
though we meet setbacks we will not give up
exercises.explanation: 即使...也 = even if...still.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sufficient-condition frame: "___ 你願意傾聽，對方就會願意溝通" (As long as)
exercises.answer: 只要
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient condition.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most formal hypothetical for "if the policy were enacted, the market would respond":
options: 假如政策付諸實施，市場便會作出回應
要是政策出來了，市場就反應了
exercises.answer: 假如政策付諸實施，市場便會作出回應
exercises.explanation: 假如...便 + 付諸實施 + 作出回應 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will surely succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 會 成功

lessons.title: Concede & refute
lessons.description: 雖然...但是 / 儘管...然而

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 雖然 這個 方案 有 風險 ， 但是 收益 很 大

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "although...however"?
exercises.answer: 儘管...然而
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 belongs in essays, news, and formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Pick the sentence that concedes a point and pushes back:
options: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面
exercises.answer: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面

exercises.prompt: "你說得有道理" means "what you say is ___"
exercises.answer: Reasonable

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the opposing view has its rationale, we still need to see another side"
exercises.answer: 儘管 對方 的 觀點 不無 道理 ， 然而 我們 仍需 看到 另一 面

exercises.prompt: What does the rebuttal structure "誠然...然而..." express?
options: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.answer: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.explanation: 誠然 ("granted / it is true that") + 然而 = a debater's classic concede-and-pivot.

exercises.prompt: the rebuttal opener
Tap the concession marker you hear
exercises.spokenText: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
雖然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
儘管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
儘管成本上升然而公司開始虧損
exercises.answer: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 儘管/雖然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/虧損 inverts result.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this concede-and-rebut:
options: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響
儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
誠然，該方案有其優勢，然而風險亦不容忽視
話雖如此，仍需考慮實際操作的可行性
exercises.answer: 儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
exercises.explanation: 儘管 lean formal; 你說的沒錯啊 / 這玩意兒沒用 are casual. Mixed register sounds inconsistent.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "雖然有問題但是值得嘗試" to formal: "___ 存在 不足 ， ___ 仍 值得 嘗試"
exercises.answer: 儘管 然而
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 雖然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 話 雖 如此 ， 我們 仍 需 考慮 其 對 中小 企業 的 影響

exercises.source: 儘管對方的觀點不無道理，然而我們仍需看到另一面
exercises.answer: Although the opponent's view has its merits, we still need to see the other side
acceptableAnswers: though the other side has a point, we must still consider another angle
the opponent's view is not without merit, however we still need to look at the other side
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 + 不無道理 + 仍需 = formal debate register.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "雖然有問題但是值得嘗試" to formal: "___ 存在不足，___ 仍值得嘗試"
exercises.hint: Two parts of the formal concessive pair
exercises.answer: 儘管 然而
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 雖然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal concede-and-rebut opener?
exercises.answer: 誠然...然而...
exercises.explanation: 誠然...然而... is the most formal debater's opener.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 話 雖 如此 ， 我們 仍 需 考慮 其 對 中小 企業 的 影響

exercises.prompt: Tap the formal concessive you hear
exercises.spokenText: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
雖然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
儘管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
儘管成本上升然而公司開始虧損
exercises.answer: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 儘管/雖然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/虧損 inverts result.

exercises.answer: That said
exercises.explanation: 話 (words) + 雖 (although) + 如此 (so / thus).

exercises.prompt: Complete the concede-and-rebut: "___，該方案有其優勢，然而風險亦不容忽視" (granted)
exercises.answer: 誠然
exercises.explanation: 誠然 = granted / it is true that — a classic debater's opener.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence preserves formal debate register?
options: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響

lessons.title: Rhetorical questions — 難道...嗎
lessons.description: Sharpen a point with a challenge

exercises.prompt: What does "難道你不知道嗎？" really mean?
options: A genuine question — does he/she know?
exercises.answer: An accusation — surely you know!
exercises.explanation: 難道...嗎 expects the answer "of course" or "of course not".

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "Could this really be the only solution?"
exercises.answer: 難道 這 是 唯一 的 解決 辦法 嗎

exercises.prompt: the rhetorical opener
"難道你忘了嗎？" implies you ___ have forgotten
exercises.answer: Shouldn't
exercises.explanation: Rhetorically, the speaker assumes you remember.

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "If even this is not a problem, then what could possibly be a problem?"
exercises.answer: 如果 這 都 不 算 問題 ， 那 還有 什麼 算 問題 呢

exercises.prompt: What does "試問，誰能在此情況下保持冷靜？" really argue?
options: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.answer: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.explanation: 試問 ("I ask") fronts a rhetorical challenge. The expected answer is the negative.

exercises.prompt: the advanced rhetorical question opener
Tap the rhetorical opener you hear

exercises.explanation: 豈能 ("how could one possibly") + 此事 ("this matter") = literary register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the rhetorical opener: "___ 這就是事實的全部？" (could it really be that)

exercises.prompt: Build the literary rhetorical "How could we ignore so many warnings?"

How could we possibly tolerate this matter
acceptableAnswers: how can we ever tolerate this

exercises.explanation: 豈能 (how could one possibly) + 此事 (this matter).

exercises.answer: 豈能
exercises.explanation: 豈能 fronts a literary rhetorical question expecting a negative answer.

exercises.prompt: Which rhetorical opener is MOST literary?
exercises.answer: 豈能

topics.title: Chéngyǔ in context
topics.description: Eight high-frequency four-character idioms used the right way

guide.intro: 成語 (chéngyǔ) are four-character idioms that compress a story or principle into one phrase. There are thousands of them, but only a few hundred are actually high-frequency. We'll meet eight that you'll see weekly in news, conversation, and writing — and learn the contexts where each lands well.

sections.text: How idioms slot into sentences

成語 typically work as adjectives, adverbs, or full predicates. Most can stand alone as a four-character verb phrase: 一舉兩得 ("two birds, one stone") can be the whole verb. Some need a 是 or 的 frame to slot in: 這是一舉兩得的事.

sections.text: Eight to remember

rows: Win-win solution / two birds, one stone
Help when help is most needed
Enter the village, follow its customs
When in Rome, do as the Romans

sections.text: 錦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
These two are taught as a pair. 錦上添花 is help when things are already good — nice but not vital. 雪中送炭 is help in a crisis — the kind people remember forever. Pick the right one when praising someone.

sections.text: Don't pile 成語 on top of 成語. One per paragraph in writing, one per minute in speech. Used sparingly they sound elegant; used densely they sound like a textbook.

topics.title: Abstract & philosophical
topics.description: Talk about ideas, ethics, fate, and meaning

guide.intro: Modern Mandarin still leans on a small cluster of fate-and-cause vocabulary inherited from Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist thought. Three words do most of the work: 緣分 (fated connection), 因果 (cause and effect), and 命運 (destiny). They aren't religious jargon — speakers use them every day to talk about relationships, outcomes, and choices. Learning the cultural framing keeps you from translating them too flatly.

sections.text: 緣分 — the right people, the right time

緣分 (yuán fèn) names the unseen tie that brings two people, or a person and a place, together. It's used loosely in romance ("we have 緣分"), friendship ("我們很有緣"), and even chance encounters. The Buddhist root is 緣 ("condition that gives rise to a meeting"); the modern register is warm, slightly fatalistic, and very common.

rows.source: 我們能再見面，真是緣分。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài jiànmiàn, zhēn shì yuán fèn.
rows.translation: That we could meet again is truly fate.

rows.pinyin: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì.
rows.translation: If fated, even a thousand miles can't keep two from meeting.

rows.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suí yuán ba.
rows.translation: Let's just let this one go where fate takes it.

sections.text: 因果 — cause and effect

因果 (yīn guǒ) literally pairs 因 (cause) with 果 (fruit / result). In Buddhist usage it names karma; in modern speech it works as a neutral "cause and effect" — useful in argument, science writing, and ethics talk alike. The four-character expression 因果報應 ("karmic retribution") keeps the moral edge.

rows.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yǒu yīn guǒ.
rows.translation: Every event has a cause and an effect.

rows.source: 我們要分析這件事的因果關係。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fēnxī zhè jiàn shì de yīn guǒ guānxi.
rows.translation: We need to analyse the causal relationship of this matter.

rows.pinyin: Zhòng shàn yīn, dé shàn guǒ.
rows.translation: Plant good causes, reap good fruits.

sections.text: 命運 — destiny you can argue with

命運 (mìng yùn) is destiny, but with more give than the English word suggests. Speakers talk about 改變命運 ("change one's destiny") and 與命運抗爭 ("struggle against fate") freely — destiny is fixed enough to name, fluid enough to push against. Adjacent terms: 天命 (heavenly mandate, more solemn), 宿命 (predetermined fate, fatalistic).

sections.text: These words sit in everyday conversation, not just temples. A friend who lands a job they nearly missed will say 這就是緣分; a parent reflecting on a child's path will say 改變命運. Don't over-translate them as "karma" or "fate" — let the context pick the English.

exercises.prompt: Why is "我見面他了" wrong?
options: 見面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我見過他的面 / 我跟他見過面
見面 only takes a time word
exercises.answer: 見面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我見過他的面 / 我跟他見過面
exercises.explanation: Separable verbs (離合詞) like 見面, 幫忙, 結婚 are V-O compounds. You can't tack a second object on; aspect markers and modifiers go between the two halves.
